title: OneHolo.ai Showcases AI Concierge Tala at AIMed26
html:
OneHolo.ai showcased Tala, its multilingual AI concierge, at the AIMed26 healthcare conference in Orlando last week. The company first introduced Tala at founder Dr. Kianor Shah’s practice in Palm Desert. It is now inviting professional associations and conference organizers to pilot the same technology as a guide for attendees, both online and on compatible displays.

Visitors to the practice website can ask Tala about services, find patient forms, or learn how to book a visit. The practice supplies the information Tala uses, while the clinical team handles questions about an individual’s care. The practice also received OneHolo’s first holographic unit, giving the team a place to train Tala on the routines of a working front desk.

“When someone is standing at the front desk and the phone rings, my team has to decide who waits,” said Shah, founder and CEO of OneHolo.ai. “I wanted Tala to answer the routine questions so our staff have more time for the conversations that need their judgment.”

In Orlando, Shah also joined fellow clinicians to discuss AI in dentistry, following meetings with delegates at the B20 USA Summit in Washington, D.C. OneHolo’s event pilot, Promo, gives organizers a way to put the technology to work at their own meetings. An attendee can ask which session covers a particular topic and where to find it. Tala draws on the organizer’s approved program. Each approved pilot includes 1,000 minutes shared across the event website and compatible devices.

Since opening early registration in June, OneHolo has built a five-product portfolio. Its business platform, InteractionOS, handles routine calls, messages, and appointment requests. Staff take over when a customer needs personal attention. Concierge guides website visitors, while Promo serves events and associations. SELF lets individuals create an authorized digital likeness using material they select. Legacy lets invited relatives explore family stories through familiar voices.

About OneHolo.ai

OneHolo.ai develops conversational AI for healthcare practices, service businesses, associations, and families. Its technology supports websites, mobile devices, kiosks, and compatible holographic displays.
